title: MLP activation: ReLU² → GELU
description: Changed MLP activation from F.relu(x).square() to F.gelu(x) to improve gradient flow
reflection: GELU activation regressed significantly (-1.7% vs baseline). The squared ReLU, despite being non-standard, is deliberately tuned for this model and training regime. Swapping for a standard activation without retuning hyperparameters made convergence worse. The baseline activation was not a bug—it was a deliberate choice. This suggests other agents should be cautious about 'fixing' seemingly odd design choices in the baseline; they are likely optimized trade-offs.
